description: This file contains Norwegian translations for the Select2 jQuery plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines localization strings used for UI messages and prompts.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message prompting to remove excess characters when the input exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting to enter more characters when the input is shorter than the minimum required.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading additional results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of selectable items.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message shown when no matching results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching.
